_comment: One list of cases for whether a marked created field blocks 'Confirm my record' (#2857). tests/test_provisional_custom_fields.py runs each against the server rule (custom_field_values.shown_to_patient) and provisional.test.ts against the page's rule (attestationBlockers), so the two cannot drift apart. disease is the record's disease text; category is the Disease Category the page resolves for it; diseases is the field's scope.

cases.name: a base field on the General tab blocks
it blocks for a record with no disease too
a field on the Labs tab blocks
a field placed on the Blood tab shows on Labs and blocks
a field on the behavior tab blocks
a field placed on no tab never blocks
a field with no approved mapping never blocks
a field of the record's own disease blocks
a field of another disease never blocks
a disease-scoped field never blocks the base record
a base field on the disease tab blocks when the record has a disease tab
a disease-tab field of the record's disease blocks
a disease-tab field never blocks a record with no disease tab
a disease-tab field of another disease never blocks
